review.finding: Tag matching ignores context: a <link> inside an HTML comment, a <script> string or a <textarea> is also fetched and rewritten; a quoted attribute containing '>' truncates the match; replacement is split/join over the whole document.
review.suggestion: Single html.replace(LINK_TAG, cb) pass; skip comments/raw-text elements.

review.finding: Relative @import / url() inside the inlined CSS stay relative and cannot load in the opaque-origin srcdoc.
review.suggestion: Document the limit in the header comment, or inline one-level @import.

review.finding: Promise.all over every distinct <link> is unbounded.
review.suggestion: Cap the number of inlined links (e.g. 20) or limit concurrency.

review.finding: Loading state returns on every text change: the iframe unmounts for a 'Loading...' frame and remounts, resetting page scripts and scroll.
review.suggestion: Keep the previous iframe until the new inlined result arrives.

review.finding: Pop-out button sits inside role=tablist but is not a tab (invalid ARIA).
review.suggestion: Move the button outside the tablist element.
